cue.text: Starbucks plans to close about 250 stores in North America.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: The company announced the move on September 24.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: It has more than 18,000 coffeehouses in the region.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Starbucks puts the affected share at about one percent.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: The company cites locations with weak financial prospects
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: or difficulty delivering the experience it wants for customers and staff.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: CNN reports roughly 300 million dollars in expected closure-related charges.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Two hundred million covers early lease exits and employee severance.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Starbucks says it will offer transfers wherever possible.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Employees it cannot place in another coffeehouse will receive severance support.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: CNN also reports a lower global opening forecast this fiscal year:
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: The closures sit alongside the company’s broader turnaround plan.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Starbucks says it is accelerating 1,500 coffeehouse uplifts and still plans new stores.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: CNN says affected cafés will display notices.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Changes will also appear in the app.
cue.speaker: Narrator

cue.text: Reporting: CNN and Starbucks. Announcement dated September 24.
cue.speaker: Narrator
